verdict.rationale: The only team-administration evidence is a Dropbox developer blog topic about listing the contents of all team-accessible namespaces. That points to a team-level API, but it says nothing about provisioning members or managing groups, and the other API evidence is about files, sharing, webhooks and SDKs. missing for 10: documented member provisioning/deprovisioning endpoints, group management endpoints, a broader admin API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the team is manageable by API — member provisioning, group management, and admin endpoints documented for automation

citations.quote: Listing the contents of all team-accessible namespaces
